long_biography.plain_text:
At Melbourne's Hellenic Museum, property businessman Harry Stamoulis has continued the cultural work begun by his father. As chairman, he announced the partnership that brought treasures from Athens's Benaki Museum to Australia, including ancient pottery, jewellery and Byzantine icons. The collection was intended to serve schoolchildren and university students as well as museum visitors.

He also owns 3XY Radio Hellas, Melbourne's round-the-clock Greek-language station. At its thirtieth anniversary, he credited his father with establishing the service and acknowledged his mother and sister's continuing involvement. He thanked the station's staff for sustaining that work.
